assets.final_prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: Chrome Web Store promotional background family
Primary request: create an abstract productivity background that suggests messy web fragments becoming clean structured blocks
Scene/backdrop: deep indigo to violet studio gradient with subtle soft grain
Subject: a restrained flow of thin luminous lines and simple translucent rectangular layers moving from loose fragments toward one aligned stack
Style/medium: premium 3D-inflected editorial illustration, precise and calm
Composition/framing: wide landscape, strong negative space across the center and right for real UI overlays, visual anchor near the lower-left edge
Lighting/mood: controlled soft glow, trustworthy, technical clarity
Color palette: #17143F, #4038D9, #6D5BFF, small cool-cyan accents
Constraints: background artwork only; no browser window, app interface, chat interface, document text, logo, icon, letters, numbers, or watermark; no fake UI; no busy center; no neon cyberpunk clutter

Common constraints:
- Background artwork only; no browser window, app interface, chat interface, document text, logo, icon, letters, numbers, or watermark.
- Keep a calm, professional productivity-tool tone.
- Leave broad low-detail zones for later insertion of real product UI and deterministic typography.
- Do not imply cloud upload, automation speed, or features beyond copying and structuring content.

visual_inspection.conclusion: 靛紫抽象背景仅在左下与左侧形成几何流动焦点；中心和右侧连续留空，可承载真实 UI。未见文字、水印、浏览器窗口、产品 UI 或聊天 UI。
